title: Blackstones 16x
description: Makes polished blackstone buttons look like piles of large-ish rocks!
body:
**This is the 16x version of Blackstones. The 32x version can be found on my profile or [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blackstones-32x) :)**
<hr>

This pack changes polished blackstone buttons to resemble medium-sized rocks.
<hr>

These can be used in various ways, such as decorating paths, concealing buttons, and more!
<hr>

The rocks also rotate randomly to add even more variety to your builds!

They are also able to be placed on walls and ceilings to add more detail!
<hr>

Thanks to [Lily of the Valley](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/lily_of_the_valley/) for the request!
